summary: Regression testing of the bug where FX stage-1 failed with 'FxConfig' object has no attribute 'ai_fast_model'. The fix works. A grep finds no cfg.ai_fast_model in engine.py, fx/engine*.py or ai_funnel.py, and FxConfig has no such attribute. In the fake-engine tests the real ai_funnel.quick_filter ran with only _ask/_chat mocked. FX _handle_signal with e.cfg=FxConfig() produced an APROBADA signal at ai_stage 2, with no FxConfig text in the note, using model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Crypto _handle_signal with a cfg lacking the attribute also gave APROBADA at stage 2, using the runtime override gpt-5.4-mini. configure()/fast_cfg() precedence is correct (explicit override > module state > FAST_MODELS). The API round trip for ai_fast_model works. One real stage-1 call for EURUSD fx returned {pass: true, confidence: 78, model: 'Claude Haiku 4.5', ms: 1772}. The iter77 suite still passes (42/42). Frontend: /hotforex loads, the IA panel is empty and has no 'Error IA' or FxConfig text, and the DB has 0 signals with 'has no attribute' in signals, fx_signals or pep_signals. In Admin → IA the fast-model select works: Sonnet 4.6 → Guardar (PUT 200) → still set after reload → back to Automático (PUT 200). Found 1 new minor issue: fast_model_auto now includes the override.

minor.issue: fast_model_auto = ai_funnel.fast_cfg()['model'] now returns the user's override, because fast_cfg() falls back to _override. With ai_fast_model='claude-sonnet-4-6', GET returns fast_model_auto='claude-sonnet-4-6'. As a result the Admin hint reads 'Automático = Claude Sonnet 4.6' and the 'Automático según proveedor · …' option shows the override instead of the provider default (Haiku). Fix: compute it as ai_funnel.FAST_MODELS.get((_cfg['source'], _cfg['provider']), _cfg['model']), for example with a helper ai_funnel.auto_model().

ui_bugs.issue: Shows the override model as the 'automatic' model after saving a non-auto choice (caused by the backend fast_model_auto issue above)

action_items: Make config.py:188 fast_model_auto ignore ai_funnel._override, so it always returns the provider default
critical_code_review_comments: ai_funnel._override is module-level state shared by all three bots. That is fine because the setting is global, but the fast_model_auto computation now mixes in the override (see the minor issue).
seed_data_creation: None. The iter77 run created 2 pep_changes events (ai_funnel/min_rr change and restore); they were deleted by _id. config.ai_fast_model is back to ''. No bots were started.
